blurb: This check grades Shared Storage Pool free space on a VIOS and is separate from ssp_cluster. No cluster is not applicable. After the cluster is present it runs lssp -clustername and compares FREE_SPACE with POOL_SIZE. IBM states that I/O operations on the virtual client partition might fail when free space falls below 5 percent of total space. Bare lssp, Size(mb), Free(mb), and rootvg are not graded. 35 percent is the default alert, not this fail-line.
